items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Brittany brought me around and there was Norman Blaze.

ctx.x: Can you remember when you hit with you on your own drum there?

Oh yeah, I can remember good. The old fellow was quite older than me and he knew how to play a little bit. You know, Brittany brought me around and there was Norman Blaze. Old boy, he died about ten years ago. I never knew him. No, he played much of his dance? He never just got up to himself and made no kind of laugh for himself. Always played a little drum. Well, quite now he was a fellow old enough to be my dad, you know. He liked my playing. He got a few little jobs like that. Then parties went up to diamonds…
I played fifteen then. Remember these parties, how old were you at the parties?
